title: Is this AI training on my prompts? · Trained On
excerpt: Is this AI training on my prompts? What each tool's own terms say, quoted and dated, and every time the answer changed.
content_html:
ChatGPT Free, Plus and Pro Yes, by default. You can opt out. Data Controls in settings, or "do not train on my content" in OpenAI's privacy portal. Temporary Chats are not used for training.
When you use our services for individuals such as ChatGPT, Sora, or Operator, we may use your content to train our models.Privacy Policy
31 Jul 2025previous capture 21 May 2025 last seen 9 Oct 2026 ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Edu and API No, unless you opt in. Opt-in only, for example through feedback mechanisms.
By default, we do not use your business data for training our models.Business Privacy Policy
31 Jul 2025first capture, may be older last seen 9 Oct 2026 Claude.ai Free, Pro and Max Yes, by default. You can opt out. Account settings. Conversations flagged for safety review and material you report as feedback are used even after opting out.
We may use your Inputs and Outputs to train and improve Anthropic AI models, unless you opt out through your account settings.Privacy Policy
8 Jun 2026 last seen 9 Oct 2026 Claude.ai Commercial (Team, Enterprise, API) No.
Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.Commercial Terms
1 Aug 2025first capture, may be older last seen 12 Mar 2026 Microsoft Copilot Consumer Copilot Yes, in certain markets. You can opt out. Copilot settings. Which markets is not stated.
In certain markets, we use conversation data to train the generative AI models in Copilot, unless you choose to opt-out of such training.Privacy Policy · last good capture 9 Dec 2025
11 Oct 2025previous capture 3 Sep 2025 last seen 9 Dec 2025 GitHub Copilot Accounts under GitHub's Terms of Service Yes, by default. You can opt out. Section J.3 of GitHub's Terms. Unless you opt out, GitHub's affiliates may also use your Inputs and Outputs.
If you provide your private repository content as Input to AI Features, we may use that Input to provide, develop, train, and improve the Service, including AI Features.Terms of Service
27 Apr 2026previous capture 10 Dec 2025 last seen 16 Sep 2026 Perplexity API No.
Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.Developer Terms
27 Aug 2024first capture, may be older last seen 10 Dec 2025 Perplexity Enterprise (data processing agreement) No.
For the avoidance of doubt, Personal Data will not be used for training of Perplexity's large language models.Data Processor Agreement
12 Aug 2025first capture, may be older last seen 10 Dec 2025 Grok Consumer (grok.com, X and apps) You choose in settings. The terms do not say which way it starts. A setting when logged in; the terms do not say which way it starts, but the apps ask you to choose at setup. Logged-out use grants xAI "full rights" to use your data for model training.
When logged into our Service, you can select whether or not you want us to use your User Content to improve our products and services and train our models.Terms of Service
1 Aug 2025previous capture 20 Nov 2023 last seen 18 May 2026 Grok xAI API and enterprise No. De-identified data derived from your use may still be used "for any lawful purpose".
For clarity, xAI shall not use any User Content to train any foundation models, large language models, or other artificial intelligence systems.Commercial Terms
18 May 2026previous capture 11 Dec 2025 last seen 18 May 2026 Cursor All plans No, unless you opt in. Training needs your explicit agreement. Preferences are managed in the app.
ANYSPHERE WILL NOT USE CONTENT TO TRAIN, OR ALLOW ANY THIRD PARTY TO TRAIN, ANY AI MODELS, UNLESS YOU'VE EXPLICITLY AGREED TO THE USE OF CONTENT FOR TRAINING.Terms of Service
14 Jun 2025previous capture 19 Apr 2025 last seen 18 Sep 2025 Windsurf (Codeium) Free Yes. No opt-out stated. None on the free tier. The opt-out is for paid tiers only.
Cognition may use Customer Data for model training purposes and to improve and enhance the Services.Terms of Service
1 Jul 2026previous capture 15 Apr 2026 last seen 1 Jul 2026 Windsurf (Codeium) Paid (Pro, Teams) Yes, by default. You can opt out. On Teams, only an administrator may opt out.
If you subscribe to a paid Service Tier, you may opt out of this use ("Opt-Out").Terms of Service
1 Jul 2026previous capture 15 Apr 2026 last seen 1 Jul 2026 DeepSeek Consumer app and platform Yes, by default. You can opt out. Listed among privacy rights: "the right to opt-out of using your Personal Data for training our models or optimizing our technologies."
To improve and develop the Services and to train and improve our technology, such as our machine learning models and algorithms.Privacy Policy
23 Feb 2025 last seen 10 Feb 2026 Jasper All plans Yes. Opt-out only in some regions. EU and UK users only, by request to [email protected]. The licence covers "modifying, improving, and enhancing artificial intelligence models".
For users located in the European Union or United Kingdom, you may have the right to object to the use of your Customer Property for the purpose of improving artificial intelligence models.Terms of Service
11 Sep 2025previous capture 25 Sep 2024 last seen 2 Oct 2025 Le Chat Free, Pro and Student Yes, by default. You can opt out. Account settings. Feedback and moderated content are used regardless.
We do not use Your Data to train our artificial intelligence models except (a) when you use the Mistral AI Products under a free subscription, Le Chat Pro or Le Chat Student and you have not opted-out of trainingTerms of Service
1 Aug 2025first capture, may be older last seen 28 Oct 2025 Le Chat Team and Enterprise No, unless you opt in. Exceptions are feedback you give and content flagged by moderation.
We do not use Your Data to train our artificial intelligence models exceptTerms of Service
1 Aug 2025first capture, may be older last seen 28 Oct 2025
